subject.title: refactor: delete the unused agent-core session harness layer

question: May this release remove the eight declared `@openclaw/agent-core` subpath exports, or must compatibility shims and a deprecation path remain?
rationale: The patch proves no remaining repository consumer, but only the package owner can decide whether these export-map entrypoints are supported for installed or external consumers and whether a breaking removal is acceptable in this release.

options.title: Retain compatibility entrypoints
options.body: Keep deprecated forwarding exports for the removed paths and schedule their removal through an explicit package compatibility plan.

options.title: Approve the breaking removal
options.body: Confirm the removed paths are not a supported shipped contract and accept immediate import failures for any downstream use.

recommendation.title: Retain compatibility entrypoints
recommendation.body: Keep deprecated forwarding exports for the removed paths and schedule their removal through an explicit package compatibility plan.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context identifies steipete as the trusted author proposing this package-boundary reduction; package-contract ownership needs their confirmation.
